rv.q: Despite dreading the show, I’m still glad I went.
Regardless of your political leanings, this Project will knock you and give you lots to think about once you recover.
The material is both fascinating and deliberately infuriating.

cn.t: This verbatim docudrama juxtaposing Anita Hill and Christine Blasey Ford's testimonies earns praise for its searing portrait of power, though some critics found the premise predictable.
